followup.resolved_subset: 2D and 3D row readers, legacy decimal grammar, bounded populated-object mesh deactivation and the boundary-suppression getter are now recovered and compared where applicable.
followup.qualification: The original assessment and its source hashes below are retained as historical context. Full token dispatch, object-ID cursor behavior, suppression-flag writers, root configuration and scientific finalization remain open.

purpose: Identify the smallest evidence-backed path from MeshStorage to a selected OBJNAM/OBJTYP/RZ/ELMCON importer, without claiming full application reconstruction.

conclusion.ready: A bounded byte-stream scanner and selected-handler adapter can be specified substantially from retained code. MeshStorage supplies the tested default-control 3D allocation and boundary subset.
conclusion.not_ready: A production-equivalent importer cannot yet be claimed: exact legacy numeric/text-stream behavior, the 2D coordinate row reader, type-7 cleanup, root/configuration transitions and post-import effects remain incomplete.
conclusion.separation: Scanner acceptance and stream position are independent contracts from object mutation, cleanup, boundary generation and derived scientific geometry. Passing array replay comparisons does not establish scanner or complete import equivalence.
conclusion.implementation_scope_proposal: First establish scanner/helper parity on bounded inputs, then implement the four-handler subset against explicit dimension/component/default controls and stable object identity. Expose unsupported recognized keywords and incomplete finalization explicitly; do not silently treat them as unknown or successful full import.

rules: The parser uses fscanf("%39s") into a 40-byte token buffer. It is a token stream, not one keyword per physical line. A longer token leaves unread bytes for subsequent reads.
Any token whose first byte is '*' takes the comment path; one fgets(buffer,1024) consumes at most 1023 following bytes. It does not drain an arbitrarily long physical line.

The first recognized dimension-bearing comment in each parser invocation sets dimensions; later comments cannot change them in that invocation. Recognition is not restricted to the beginning of the file.
Recognized forms in the comment remainder include DEFORM followed by 3D/F3 or 2D/F2; DEFORM-3D/F3; DEFORM-2D/F2; and DEFORM-MACH2, DEFORM-DIESTRESS2, DEFORM-MACHDIST2, DEFORM-MICROSTRUCTURE2.
The primary root is set to 2 or 3 through virtual slot zero; an available linked root is explicitly set to the complementary dimension in this parser branch.
Comment parsing uses unchecked sscanf("%s %s") into local buffers. Oversized or incomplete comments are not a safe, fully characterized compatibility domain.
Lookup scans 304 table rows with case-sensitive strcmp. OBJNAM/OBJTYP/RZ/ELMCON are category 2, IDs 144/145/159/173.
Unknown lookup returns ID 305/category 0, consumes one bounded fgets remainder, and warns except for exact token SRFNRG. Unknown lookup does not itself update the remembered import error.
Recognized category 2 dispatches to 0x14038b8a0 after current/alternate root selection by 0x1401d81b0. Other recognized categories are not unknown keywords.
Handler status 0 continues; 2 prints Reading Error and continues; 3 prints Data Error and continues; another nonzero status exits immediately.
The remembered status is overwritten by each nonzero handler status. EOF returns the LAST nonzero status, or zero if none; later successful records do not erase it.
No general resynchronization or rollback follows handler errors. Parsing resumes from the exact stream position left by the handler.

For these four handlers, the object-ID local is initialized to zero before fscanf("%i"). Only return -1 is immediately rejected; a zero-conversion result leaves ID zero, and lookup returns null/status 2.
This initialized local is visible in the saved handler and narrows the older contract's uncertainty about malformed object-ID locals. Failed-conversion stream consumption still needs observation.
Selection occurs before reading name/type/count/arity payloads. A valid missing positive ID can therefore create an object even when its later payload fails.
Existing positive IDs retain identity; missing positive IDs append intermediate type-7 placeholders, then the requested constructor-default object. Nonpositive IDs yield null/status 2.
The tested 3D requested-object subset initializes empty name, type 0, no mesh, zero counts and kind 2/arity 4. This is not the complete constructor.
After object-ID fscanf, consume one bounded fgets remainder, then read a second bounded fgets as the name. EOF in either read fails without copying the name.
Replace the first LF with NUL; copy at most 80 bytes; trim trailing NUL, space, CR and LF by backward scan; terminate after the last retained byte.
Preserve leading whitespace and trailing tabs. Interpret bytes through the first NUL, without inventing Unicode decoding or the DB loader's different name limit.
A name longer than the fgets bound leaves unread input; an 81-byte-to-1023-byte name is truncated to the 80-byte stored name while its already-read suffix is consumed.
Helpers initialize destination values to zero, read at most 1023 bytes with fgets, replace commas with spaces, then scan the buffer.
Only sscanf return -1 is a reader failure. A nonblank malformed token causing zero conversions, or a short row causing fewer conversions than fields, is accepted with untouched outputs left zero.
413de0 scans %i; 413ee0 scans %i %i; 414200 scans label plus four %i values; 415880 scans %i plus three %Flf values.
413de0 can skip one LF-only blank line when its option is nonzero; 414200 can loop over LF-only blank lines when its option is nonzero. The selected RZ/ELMCON call sites pass zero.
The existing code establishes format strings and control flow, not full equivalence between the embedded legacy CRT and modern C++ numeric conversion routines.

Fresh parent-supplied REA evidence ev_4f99c41662703985b0ba14f4f334e9a5d69f12302acafa0bf85d0429837b8af2 establishes 414600: zero all nine integer outputs; fgets with size 1024; optional loop over LF-only blank lines; comma replacement; nine %i conversions; failure only read EOF or sscanf -1. The ELMCON call passes skip-blank zero. Numeric edge-case runtime parity remains unresolved.
Read two integers from the current remainder via 413ee0. File codes 1..5 map to internal 0..4; 7 maps to 6; 6 preserves prior type; every other code maps to 7.
Store the second integer at object+0x2154, then invoke deactivation if the resulting type is 7, including code 6 applied to an already inactive object.
Deactivation clears name, mesh flag, node/element counts and fields +0x888/+0x88c after deeper cleanup, and resets 100 boundary/subobject records. The complete cleanup effects are unresolved.
The malformed type fixture produced status zero and type 7; this is not evidence that inactive cleanup can safely be replaced with assigning a fresh MeshStorage.

RZ reads count, writes count, clears/reallocates node arrays and defaults, then reads rows directly into sequential destination slots. Parsed row labels do not choose storage slots. It does not set mesh-present.
3D ELMCON reads count and arity; rejects arities other than 4/8 before changing the count; accepted arity updates kind and topology fields before clearing/reallocating element arrays.
2D ELMCON reads count only and uses the four-integer row helper. Its allocation wrapper can force width 4 depending on object+0x39c0; selected object arity and allocated width must not be conflated.
Row failure returns status 2 with already-applied count/type/array writes and successful prefixes retained. A failed row helper also zeroes its own output destinations before attempting the read.
After all ELMCON rows succeed, mesh-present is set even if count is zero. Boundary construction occurs only when 39aa20 returns zero.

MeshStorage matches 31 recorded 3D snapshots with explicit default controls, including 1643 descriptor snapshots and 11 direct-buffer/boundary snapshots. This validates its bounded storage composition, not scanner return codes or every full-import side effect.
When enabled, reset two per-import flags before opening; record filename; open; set import option field; parse; reset option; close; clear filename; finalize; return parser status.
Open failure returns 1 without entering the parse/close/finalization branch. Filename cleanup on this branch is not shown.
Finalization is called when enabled even after parser error. It runs simulation-control handling, material-reference processing, active-object geometry handling, then conditional step updates.

Boundary construction at successful ELMCON and the wrapper's end-of-file finalization are different operations. Current MeshStorage implements neither the entire latter nor all boundary-dependent arrays.

required_gaps.question: Confirm embedded fscanf/sscanf, file-open mode at 0x14052553c, fgets text translation and comma replacement semantics. Characterize %i and %Flf for bounded valid/short/malformed inputs before substituting a modern scanner.
required_gaps.minimum_next_action: Use saved assembly/callee references first; inspect missing helper 323970 and fopen mode bytes. Then passively observe row-reader status and destination bytes for decimal/octal/hex integers, exponent forms, commas, tabs, CRLF/LF, trailing junk and short rows.
required_gaps.qualification: Overflow, nonfinite values, embedded NUL/Ctrl-Z, locale and overlong physical lines require either explicit exclusions or separate characterization. Do not reproduce memory-unsafe unchecked buffer behavior as a production requirement.

smallest_runtime_matrix_after_static_rec: Four independent row-helper cases: complete row, short numeric row, malformed first token and LF-only row/EOF; compare return code, exact destination bytes and next dispatched token. Use safe bounded counts and fresh private run directories.
Object ID malformed versus absent versus zero: verify initialized-zero behavior, object creation timing, parser continuation and final returned status.
Names: leading spaces, trailing tab, empty line, 80/81-byte values and EOF after header; compare exact stored bytes. Treat long physical-line splitting as a separate bounded test.

Parser recovery: unknown keyword then valid OBJNAM; row error then valid OBJNAM; two distinct handler error statuses where obtainable within the authorized subset. Compare token sequence and last-error return.
Only after cleanup recovery: populated mesh -> invalid OBJTYP -> code 6 -> valid type. Compare identity, descriptor history, arity, direct buffers, boundaries and name before/after each stage.
ordering_constraints: Retain byte-oriented input and exact cursor position across token reads and bounded line reads; do not preprocess the entire file into clean lines or normalize case.
Apply the first recognized per-file dimension header before subsequent dispatch; select the appropriate current/alternate root for each recognized data keyword.
Select/create the object before consuming the payload, so later failure does not erase created identity or placeholders.
For OBJTYP, scan values, map type, write secondary field, then perform type-7 cleanup.
For RZ, read count, replace storage/defaults, then stream rows into their final sequential destinations.
For ELMCON, validate 3D arity and update kind before count/allocation, stream rows, mark mesh only after successful completion, then conditionally build boundary and dependent state.
Preserve completed mutations on reader error and resume tokenization from the actual cursor. Do not assume transactional import or skip a whole malformed block.
After parsing, perform wrapper teardown before optional end-of-file finalization, including error returns. Keep parser status distinct from finalization observations.
Freeze scanner/adapter candidates before comparing retained or fresh independent fixtures. Storage snapshots and scanner acceptance/status must be compared separately.
scope_exclusions: No execution of the original, new REA session, source implementation or commit was performed for this assessment.
DBREAD, KFREAD, GENDB and other command-category behavior are outside this selected importer research scope.
A four-keyword implementation cannot infer safe payload skipping for all other recognized keywords; full-file compatibility needs their actual handlers or an explicit unsupported result.
Negative counts, signed overflow, failed allocation, malformed connectivity outside recovered builder domains, sharing and arbitrary dimensions remain unsupported unless separately characterized.
